english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone defeats an opponent decisively and by a large margin.

examples.english: They resoundingly defeated their opponents in the final, and everyone was overjoyed.
examples.traditional: 佢哋喺決賽大勝對手，成班人開心到不得了。
